procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; corporate_lifecycle::union_organisation_strike_and_binding_settlement drives low pay to organisation growth, a ballot, a two-week bargaining deadline, strike state, and a binding thirteen-week settlement with balanced books. Plus crates/cw-sim/tests/unions.rs: a settlement under 95 percent of the demand is refused and 95 percent accepted, a strike leaves three tenths of staff, and a ballot outcome survives save and reload.
limitations: Union and worker behaviour is an aggregate weekly model; no individual worker identity or external labour board.
